title: Surge Protective Device (SPD) Price in Pakistan 2026 — Type 1/2/3 SPD Selection, IEC 61643-11 Compliance & Industrial Panel Surge Protection | Complete Buyer Guide
summary_html: Complete buyer guide to Surge Protective Device (SPD) selection and pricing in Pakistan 2026. Covers Type 1, Type 2, and Type 3 SPD selection methodology using the IEC 62305 Lightning Protection Zone (LPZ) approach, IEC 61643-11 compliance requirements, Pakistan-specific risks including WAPDA summer over-voltage, loadshedding switching transients, TNS vs TT earthing mismatch (Karachi vs DISCO zones), counterfeit SPD prevalence, and monsoon lightning density. Includes a 14-row PKR price table (PKR 800–650,000 range), Faisalabad spinning mill worked example with full SPD specification, 10-point selection checklist, and 7 common procurement mistakes unique to the Pakistani market.
